question: Should ambiguous outbound rows with no reconciliation-capable adapter stay pending with backoff instead of becoming terminal failed entries after the pacing bug is fixed?
rationale: Tests can prove either behavior, but the choice changes operator visibility, upgrade behavior, and message-delivery recovery semantics for existing ambiguous rows.

options.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
options.body: Merge the behavior after the no-op deferral pacing bug is fixed and exact-head validation is green.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed State
options.body: Reject or pause this PR and keep current main's terminal failed behavior until the broader delivery ledger is designed.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Ask for a doctor, UI, or API path that exposes deferred ambiguous rows before changing them to remain pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Recoverable Pending
recommendation.body: Merge the behavior after the no-op deferral pacing bug is fixed and exact-head validation is green.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses core state/queue semantics and operator behavior, and steipete appears in the SQLite queue migration plus recent recovery co-author history.
